title: Spiritual Death
definition: Spiritual Death refers to human inability and frailty under the effects of sin and the fall.
summary: Spiritual Death refers to human inability and frailty under the effects of sin and the fall.
christFocus: Christ gives life to the dead and strength to the weak.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Spiritual Death teaches that humanity needs divine grace, resurrection life, and Spirit-given strength. Scripture tells the truth about humanity without denying dignity and without minimizing the ruin sin has brought.

God gives this truth so people may stop hiding and come into the light. People often trust willpower until weakness reveals their need for god. The Bible’s honesty is mercy because what remains hidden cannot be healed rightly.

Christ enters the truth this doctrine exposes. Christ gives life to the dead and strength to the weak. In Him, sinners are not left under guilt, shame, bondage, fear, or death; they are called to repentance, faith, restoration, and new life by the power of the Holy Spirit.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content:
People need this truth because sin, shame, weakness, and brokenness are not solved by denial. People often trust willpower until weakness reveals their need for god. Scripture tells the truth so that people may stop hiding and come to Christ.

It also protects believers from shallow answers. Humanity needs forgiveness, new birth, restoration, and Spirit-empowered obedience, not merely better circumstances or stronger willpower.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Stop trusting self-sufficiency and receive strength from Christ. Bring this doctrine into prayer, Scripture, and daily obedience. Ask the Holy Spirit to make the truth real in your thinking, desires, relationships, and next faithful step with Christ.
